jobs.occupation: Field Service Engineer (all genders) Dresden (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Everything we do in Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We are dedicated to being the trusted supplier of high-tech materials, services and specialty chemicals for the electronics, automotive and cosmetics industries. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.

Your Role

As a Field Service Engineer (all genders) you will be affiliated with our Dresden office while providing field service support to customer sites across Germany and, when required, throughout Europe. In this role, you will install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair production material systems used in semiconductor manufacturing. These systems enable the production of chips found in technologies such as smartphones, LEDs, and flat-screen TVs. You will ensure the reliable operation of gas and chemical distribution systems, blending equipment, critical monitoring, and life-safety systems while delivering excellent customer service. In this role, you will perform preventive maintenance, equipment inspections, technical troubleshooting, and accurate service documentation, while providing practical solutions for equipment operation and configuration. This position requires up to 85% travel and a strong commitment to quality, safety, and operational excellence.

Who you are

- Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another technical discipline
- 2+ years of experience in the semiconductor, chemical or other manufacturing setting is an advantage
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to interpret technical documentation
- Experience in performing preventive maintenance, equipment troubleshooting, and documenting service activities
- Committed to quality, safety, and following established procedures and escalation processes
- Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to work independently and remotely;  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; basic German language skills are required
- Physically able to perform the essential duties of the role, including lifting equipment, climbing ladders, working in confined spaces, and wearing and using required personal protective equipment (PPE)
- ISO 9000/9001 awareness or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes is an advantage; A valid passport and driver’s license with a clean driving record (past 36 months) are required

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

As the Site Quality Leader, you will own the Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions for the Kiel manufacturing site, leading an organization of approximately 130 personnel. You will provide strategic, regulatory, and technical leadership to ensure the sustainable performance and compliance of this high impact site within the Elanco network.

Your Responsibilities:

• Oversee all aspects of Quality Management to ensure regulatory standards are met, regularly assessed, and reported to global leadership.

• Drive readiness for Health Authority inspections (PAI, directed, etc.) and ensure all GMP follow up actions from audits are effectively actioned.

• Manage the organizational Quality budget and deploy operational excellence strategies to drive lab and site-wide productivity.

• Recruit and develop global talent to build a high-performance culture and a robust succession pipeline for critical Quality roles.

• Partner cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and R&D to ensure quality objectives are achieved during product transfers and new launches.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific field.

• Experience: A minimum of 10 years of management or project management experience in the pharmaceutical industry (DP/API), including at least 5 years specifically in Quality Assurance.

• Comprehensive knowledge of global cGMP requirements and a proven track record in inspection management with authorities such as the FDA and EMA.

• Fluency in English and German.

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):

• Technical understanding of DP/API manufacturing and testing processes.

• Demonstrated ability to lead through transformation and drive digital roadmaps.

• Strong competency in Quality Risk Management techniques and problem-solving in ambiguous environments.

• Experience in both site-level and network-level Quality leadership.

• Experience with Tablets or Liquids is preferred.

Additional Information:

Location: Kiel Manufacturing Site, Germany

Your Job

Are you motivated to actively shape and lead innovation in the exciting field of embedded software development? We are looking for a dedicated and qualified individual to strengthen our team and play a key role in the implementation of our Wireless Charging and Wireless Connectivity projects.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will be a key member of our Wireless Charging Team, driving product development and ensuring the successful launch of our products in global markets. Your responsibilities will include software-engineering tasks throughout the entire product lifecycle process – e.g. planning, design, implementation, bug fixing, software module testing, documentation and progress reporting.

Our Team

You will join a highly skilled local engineering team based in Bochum, consisting of a small group of experienced technology experts. Within this setup, you will work in a compact and highly collaborative environment with short reporting lines, enabling fast decision-making, direct communication, and a high level of personal ownership.

At the same time, you will be part of a global engineering organization with more than 200 colleagues across Europe, North America, and Asia. This international setup gives you the opportunity to contribute beyond your local scope and play a role in projects with global reach.

In your day-to-day work, you will closely interact with cross-functional teams at our global sites – in particular System Architects, Electronic Developers, and System Testers – ensuring strong alignment across disciplines throughout the entire product development lifecycle.

What You Will Do

• Perform software-engineering tasks throughout the entire product lifecycle process (planning, design, implementation, bug fixing, software module testing, documentation and progress reporting)

• Software development in embedded C and Python languages

• HW/SW debugging

• Product Validation support

• Preparing and participation in Automotive SPICE assessments

• Qi Compliance testing

• Acting as an interface to internal and external testing laboratories and service providers on Qi Compliance

• Monitoring new developments and trends in international standards and regulations

Who You Are

• MSc in electrical engineering, information science or equivalent

• Strong knowledge in embedded programming, systematic debugging methodology and -tools and software development processes

• Expert level knowledge of embedded C programming & Python

• Experience in software development in a similar environment

• Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken

• Great team player with the ability of operating internationally across different cultures and countries

• Curious engineer who actively keeps up with industry trends, engages in professional communities, and fosters a strong knowledge-sharing mindset

What Will Put You Ahead

• PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or any related field will be highly valued

• Contribution motivated mindset – We truly appreciate curiosity, self-actualization within your domain, and knowledge sharing abilities

• Wireless Charging Qi technology (preferably)

• Solid understanding of Digital Signal Processing (DSP)

What We Offer

• Jobrad (Bike leasing)

• Corporate fitness membership (Hansefit)

• Health offerings

• Employee discounts through Corporate Benefits

• Company pension scheme (BAV)

• Capital-forming benefits (VwL)

• Employee Assistant Program (EAP)

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Your new team: As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor in a cross-functional product team where your work has real, visible impact. You will design, build, and maintain our mobile applications using React Native, with a strong focus on Android, helping deliver high-quality, scalable mobile experiences.

You will collaborate closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, share your technical expertise with peers, and help raise the bar for code quality and engineering excellence. If you enjoy clean architecture, thoughtful problem-solving, and building software that truly matters, this is the role for you.
What you can expect:
• Build and evolve mobile solutions: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality React Native applications.
• Own architecture and technical decisions: Understand platform specifics, runtime behavior, dependencies, and deployment pipelines to ensure maintainable, efficient, and scalable mobile solutions.
• Deliver high-quality code: Write clean, readable, and well-documented code that follows industry standards and mobile best practices, supported by robust automated testing.
• Work close to the business: Develop a strong understanding of customer needs and business context, translating real-world problems into effective mobile solutions.
• Drive execution and predictability: Estimate technical solutions and component-level requirements accurately, contributing to reliable delivery and team throughput.
• Collaborate and share knowledge: Actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and cross-team collaboration while promoting best practices and shared ownership.
• Take ownership and grow others: Lead challenging initiatives, mentor team members, and contribute to improving engineering processes and technical standards.
• Continuously improve: Take on larger initiatives over time, enhancing both the product and the way the team builds software.

Your profile
• Strong mobile engineering foundation: Solid experience with React Native and a strong understanding of Android development using Java and or Kotlin, enabling quick adaptation to our tech stack and patterns.
• Production experience: Proven track record of building and shipping mobile applications in production environments, with deep knowledge of Android platform specifics and mobile UI and UX best practices.
• API and data integration skills: Experience integrating REST APIs and managing data within mobile applications.
• Testing mindset: Good understanding of mobile testing strategies including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, with a focus on reliable, automated test coverage.
• Cloud and DevOps awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and modern CI and CD practices.
• Product-oriented thinking: You care about delivering meaningful features that create value for users and improve the overall mobile experience.
• Collaborative communication style: Strong communication skills and enjoyment in working within cross-functional teams, contributing positively to engineering culture.
• Security and compliance awareness: Understanding of mobile security best practices and data protection requirements.
• Nice to have: Advanced experience with native Android development, native module integration, performance optimization, or offline-first architectures.
• Language skills: Fluent in written and spoken English.

What we offer:
• Flexibility for Your Lifestyle : Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
• Ergonomic Work Environment : For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
• Independent Work : With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
• Grow with Us : Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
• Team Spirit : Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
• Mobility Your Way : Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
• Stay Active : Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
• Secure Your Future : Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
• Tailored Benefits : We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

**Do you enjoy bridging the gap between people and departments? Do you find it easy to communicate with different audiences and are interested in both the business and technical aspects of your work? Then we have the right position for you! Vestas is looking for a Plant Technical Support Engineer, Specialist (m/f/d)!**

Region NCE and Global Offshore > NCE > Technical Operations North 

Technical Operations is part of Service NCE (Northern & Central Europe) and supports the organization in the installation and maintenance of a variety of SCADA systems for the control of medium- and large-scale wind turbines. Our mission is to transform a group of wind turbines into a fully operational power plant that meets contractual and regional requirements. Our customers are mainly larger energy supply companies and professional investors.

Your tasks 

As a Plant Operations Specialist, you are the technical anchor point for the entire department. You will report directly to the Director and contribute to the strategic and technical direction of the division.

- Maintain an overview of new research and development (R&D) products and accompany their operational implementation
- Actively support technical escalations and risks for our business
- Be the point of contact for our four technical communities and ensure that initiatives are aligned and add value to the business
- Actively engage stakeholders and participate in global and regional communities
- Advise management on technical gaps, priorities, regional risks, etc.

Qualifications 

We are looking for candidates with proven leadership experience in a technical environment. This position does not focus primarily on your technical expertise, but on your ability to identify synergies, align stakeholders around common goals, and steer the technical agenda in a way that adds value to the business. You will be part of an operational department, but at the same time you will have the overarching perspective.

- Degree or comparable educational background in information technology, automation technology or telecommunications
- Strong leadership skills, for example as a project manager or manager
- knowledge of the wind energy industry; Experience with SCADA systems is an advantage
- Fluent in written and spoken English

Competencies

- Excellent communication skills as well as the ability to convey complex technical topics in an understandable way
- Professional skills in stakeholder management
- Ability to work independently and set the technical direction for a team

What we offer 

We offer an exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, cooperative and international working environment within renewable energies. We attach great importance to initiative, a sense of responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. With the appropriate motivation, performance and potential, you will have attractive career prospects within Vestas.

Learn more 

Your primary place of work will be Aarhus or Videbæk in Denmark. Alternatively, Malmö (Sweden) as well as Husum or Hamburg (Germany) are also possible.
You should expect to travel for about 20 days per year. If your skills and qualifications match this profile, we look forward to receiving your application in English by 20.09.2026 at the latest. Please note: We may adjust or withdraw our job postings and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the specified application deadline.
For more information on the position, please contact recruiter Rebecka Thorell at: rbthr@vestas.com

jobs.description:
Company Description

We Are Wholesale. We turn opportunities into results, shaping the future of wholesale.

At METRO, we’re more than a global food wholesaler. We are ONE METRO: a diverse team of over 85,000 colleagues across more than 30 countries, united by one mission: enabling our 15 million customers to create meaningful moments in hospitality and independent trade.

We shape the M with passion, commitment, and growth mindset. This means taking on responsibility, making our company your company and creating a business together that remains true to its roots but always seeks new solutions.

Job Description

Do you have a passion for digital marketing, e-commerce, and data-driven decision-making? Would you like to gain hands-on experience in a growing Wholesale Media business while working with international teams and leading technology partners? Then join our Global Wholesale Media team.

Wholesale Media is METRO's Retail Media business, connecting supplier brands with professional customers across Europe's leading international food wholesaler. As part of our team, you will contribute to shaping and growing this exciting business area across multiple European markets.

As a Wholesale Media Business Expert, you will support the planning, execution, and optimization of Wholesale Media campaigns across multiple European countries. Working closely with local teams, external partners and ad operations, you will help ensure campaigns are delivered successfully and generate measurable business impact. You will also contribute to shaping and evolving our Wholesale Media strategy by providing performance insights, supporting strategic initiatives and helping to identify opportunities for growth across markets.

- Support the Squad Lead in developing and delivering the overall Wholesale Media strategy for Metro.
- Collaborate with the Squad Lead and cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns align with business objectives and partner requirements.
- Follow Digital Media trends, ad tech developments, and competitive positioning, translating market intelligence into actionable Metro strategies.
- Ensure that we hit our Wholesale Media revenue target end-to-end — from pushing countries to secure more local campaigns, continuous tracking of all digital/media KPIs, forecasting, and corrective action when performance deviates.
- Support the Squad Lead in partnering with the global procurement team to negotiate and secure optimal partner budgets.
- Develop and work with local Wholesale Media Champions across markets — providing guidance, toolkits, and performance frameworks to enable consistent execution globally.
- Represent Wholesale Media priorities across squads and platforms to secure resource allocation and development support from Squads including but not limited to M.Web, M.Shop, M.Companion, Metro Markets and other solutions to ensure smooth campaign operations and feature development.
- Present Wholesale Media projects to countries, customers and Metro Markets, providing continuous updates on revenue performance by channel, country and customer.
- Coordinate campaign delivery with local teams, media partners, and the Ad Operations team.
- Oversee campaign setup, creative approvals and ensure adherence to campaign plans.
- Ensure media plans, creative assets and campaign requirements are delivered on time and respecting METROs B2B DNA.
- Build and maintain dashboards to track campaign performance, optimize and create processes for effective collaboration with internal & external teams.
- Provide actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders to optimize media ROI.
- Support the external presence of our Wholesale Media offering by supporting presentations, customer meetings, industry events and trade fairs, helping to strengthen our market presence.

Qualifications

- 1-2 years of experience in digital marketing, media, e-commerce, retail media, or a related field.
- Basic understanding of digital advertising and performance marketing KPIs such as CTR, ROAS, and conversions.
- Possess strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and translate insights into actionable campaign optimizations.
- Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics or Looker Studio.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate technical and business information clearly and effectively to various stakeholders.

Additional Information

- Work-life balance: Flexible working hours with the option of mobile working in agreement with your line manager, 30 days of holidays.
- Training: A comprehensive training offer via our own training center or externally.
- Well-being: Health days with lots of health checks and information about your well-being, company medical care including a range of preventive services, such as flu shots, OTHEB employee assistance program.
- Exciting life on campus: Free gym and sports classes, Rioba coffee bar, canteen with discounted meals for employees, many campus events.
- Discounts: discounted Jobticket as well as discounts in our wholesale stores and at many partner companies.
- Comfort: Good transport connections, free parking spaces, JobBike.
- Company pension plan: You will receive a contribution to your company pension.
- Family driven: Three daycare centers for children on campus, support of holiday camps for children of employees.
- Ready to build what’s next? Find us at careers.metroag.de and follow us on Instagram (@metro_careers) and Linkedin (@METRO/makro).

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Release Train Engineer (RTE) you are the operational lead of our Steam Turbine New Unit Agile Release Train (ART) – around 100 people from design, engineering, validation, industrialization and product management, working together across several sites in Europe and beyond. 

You keep development flowing across these disciplines and locations, make our cadence and events count and turn strategy into predictable delivery. You are the person who sees the whole train, anticipates where it will slow down and clears the track before it becomes a problem.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Plan and facilitate PI Planning end-to-end and run ART Sync, System Demos and Inspect & Adapt, so that alignment and transparency work even across distributed teams and time zones 
* Together with Product Management and Business Owners, keeping the ART backlog aligned to portfolio priorities and translate a complex hardware roadmap into commitments the teams can actually deliver 
* Making delivery predictable by tracking progress against real outcomes – the System Demo, not status slides – and by managing risks and dependencies across the value stream from concept to industrialization
* Keeping the flow moving by maintaining the ART Kanban, making work-in-progress visible, using flow metrics such as predictability and flow time to spot bottlenecks early and resolving or escalating impediments decisively
* Coaching teams, Product Management, System Architects and Business Owners – not by prescribing process but by asking the right questions and building an environment where problems surface early and openly
* Driving continuous improvement through Inspect & Adapt, communities of practice and the Lean-Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) and creating data-based transparency on ART health for leadership decision

What You Bring

* An engineering or technical degree is welcome – we weigh demonstrated experience, mindset and results at least as highly
* Several years of hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, having led an Agile Release Train through multiple Program Increments – not theory, but demonstrated delivery
* Experience in physical product, engineering or industrial development environments and an understanding of their realities: long lead times, prototypes and testing, supplier and manufacturing dependencies, hardware/software interplay
* Strong practical command of SAFe and Lean-Agile ways of working, ideally backed by a SAFe RTE or SPC certification, combined with a data-driven mindset for flow and delivery metrics 
* Strong facilitation skills and leadership without authority: you align large, distributed groups, steer difficult conversations and gain commitment across functions, sites and cultures
* Fluency in German and English, ease in an international, multi-site engineering environment, and a willingness to travel between locations as needed

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Your role: Laboratory Assistant in Quality Control (m/f/d)

The position is initially limited to 2 years.

In this technically demanding role, you will be largely responsible for the practical implementation and maintenance of our analytical test procedures. Your focus will be on ensuring robust analysis in accordance with international standards directly in the laboratory.

Your Responsibilities:

- Wide-ranging analysis: You will apply chromatographic (HPLC, GC) and wet chemical methods to ensure precise quality control, maintaining data integrity through GMP-compliant documentation and modern laboratory standards (e.g., 5S).
- Pharmacopoeia compliance: You will independently establish and verify analytical methods according to applicable monographs (e.g. EP, USP) and carry out verifications in regulatory revisions.
- Method optimization & CAPA management: You will experimentally investigate and optimize analytical procedures in the context of deviations and CAPA measures to sustainably increase methodological robustness.
- Conducting validation studies: You will carry out method validations and verifications for new products and feedstocks practically on the device and strictly comply with GMP requirements.
- Securing method transfer (APVs): You will develop "best practices" for analytics and record them in supplementary audit regulations (APVs) to ensure consistent application of the methods across the team.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Education: You have completed training as a chemical laboratory assistant (m/f/d), CTA (m/f/d) or a comparable qualification and 2+ years relevant professional experience in pharmaceutical quality control.
- Expertise: You have in-depth, field-tested knowledge in instrumental analysis (HPLC, GC, spectroscopy) as well as in the application of international pharmacopoeia (EP, USP).
- Languages: Fluent German and good English skills for working with international pharmacopoeia.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Methodological competence: Experience in the practical processing of methodological issues in the context of CAPA processes and in the implementation of method validations.
- Way of working: High level of technical understanding of laboratory processes, work reliably in the implementation of complex monographs and passion for working directly in the laboratory.
- IT affinity: Experience with MS Office and chromatography data systems (e.g. Empower) and SAP.

What we offer you – Why Elanco?

- Attractive salary according to the chemical tariff (MTV), full 13th month salary (Christmas bonus) and 40 € holiday pay per day. Plus: employer-financed pension scheme**.**
- Work-life balance: 37.5-hour week and 30 days of vacation. On top of that, there's the "future amount" (up to 5 extra days off or cash), overtime? Are recorded and compensated for by free time**.**
- Well-being: Hansefit membership, annual events (our employee party is legendary!) and preventive care offers directly on site.
- Convenient commute: Subsidy for the job ticket and free parking.
- Benefits: Employee share purchase program and corporate benefits platform.

Additional Information:

- Location: Kiel, Germany - On-site Work Environment
- Travel: 0%
- Position: Limited contract of 2 years.

TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in Germany. 

The new **Center for Synergy of Systems (SynoSys)** develops transdisciplinary approaches and methods in the fields of network science, data science and citizen science in order to conduct integrative research into complex phenomena at the interfaces between biomedicine, social sciences and life sciences. SynoSys will contribute to the emergence of a scientific vision for healthy human development in which physical and mental health are collectively considered in an increasingly digital and networked social and physical environment. As part of SynoSys the Research Group Computational Social Science is focused on the societal impact of digitalization. The group aims to better understand the dynamics of the complex dissemination of information online and its impact on culture, political behavior and democracy. We employ a broad set of methods, spanning agent-based modeling, time-series analysis, network science and natural language processing, to behavioral experiments in the lab and in the field. Data sources are diverse, either collected from online platforms, recruited participants or data donation approaches. To cover this spectrum, we aim for an inherent transdisciplinary approach and methodological innovation. 

For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution. 

At the Center Synergy of Systems (SynoSys), the Research Group Computational Social Sciences offers, subject to the availability of resources, a position as

Research Associate / PhD Student / PostDoc (m/f/x)

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E13 TV-L)

starting at the earliest possible date. The position is limited until September 30, 2029 and part of the project TRACE: Transparent Research on Algorithmic Content Exposure in Europe, which is funded by the Mercator Foundation. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG).

Tasks:

The project will include scientific research and collaboration with the Institute of International Law, Intellectual Property and Technology Law at TUD to draft applications for accessing research data under the Digital Services Act Article 40. The core task will be to analyze the resulting data sets, focusing on the causal inference of algorithmic influence on content dynamics and offline outcomes. Other tasks include writing of scientific publications for relevant Journals, conducting detailed literature searches, participating in professional conferences, presenting the research and its projects.

Requirements: 

- university degree in an area of applied computational sciences 
- strong interest in working in a trans-disciplinary research environment at the interface of computer science, law and social sciences 
- methodological interest in platform data and causal inference
- experience with the Digital Services Act and its data access rights
- proficiency in data science applications in Python or R
- ideally experience with NLP, large language models, longitudinal data and data privacy/anonymization
- ability to work in a collaborative interdisciplinary environment
- good command of spoken and written English

We offer:

A unique opportunity to contribute to complex science research incl. topics like information propagation on social networks, the role of platform algorithms for societal risks. 

- 30 days of paid annual leave and a year-end bonus payment; additional pension provision (VBL) 
- a dynamic and international research environment with a high degree of creative freedom 
- an interesting and responsible position where you will get to know the diverse tasks and developments in the research field and specific area of expertise 
- flexible working hours and home office arrangements 
- diverse offerings for health promotion and work-life balance, for example, through our family office or our health management program 
- numerous opportunities for further education, including language courses, IT training, and seminars for professional development 
- possibility to participate in the wide range of activities offered by the university sports program. 

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. TU Dresden, Center for Synergy of Systems (SynoSys), Dr. Philipp Lorenz-Spreen, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.
